marks.title: Pulled gait
marks.text: She hangs from her pole tips, narrow, trailing a little behind them. The tips pull her along the wire; she makes no lift.

marks.title: She sees it
marks.text: A trolleybus on her pair of wires. Her tips will not brake at all: one short flare, one pull of her poles.

marks.title: Flare kick
marks.text: She spreads flat against the air for a moment while her tips hold their speed. The air throws her back; the wire pushes her tips to keep them going.

marks.title: Top of the back swing
marks.text: Narrow again, weightless for a moment, well above where she hung. Her tips have not slowed.

marks.title: Bottom of the drive
marks.text: She falls forward through the swing and pulls her poles in through the bottom. The swing speeds up as they shorten, on top of a tip speed she never gave away.
facts: 1.5 m, on their way to 1.0 m

marks.title: Release at 60°
marks.text: Both tips open. She leaves the wire faster than she cruised: the swing adds to a tip speed that never dropped.

marks.title: Up between the wires
marks.text: She rises through the wire plane just behind the trolleybus's collector shoes, narrow, touching neither wire.

marks.title: Apex, stretched
marks.text: No hoop. The backward turn the swing gave her is all she needs: 0.5 turn in the air, stretched out, brings her poles round from up and back to down and forward.

marks.title: The catch
marks.text: One tip per wire, landing already running at her speed, which is still about her cruise speed: she gave none away. The tips hold it while she swings under them. No circle.

marks.title: Swinging under
marks.text: She falls behind and under her tips. The tips cannot hold against the swing, so she kills it the gymnast's way: poles short near the top of each swing, long through the bottom, and the coils push only when the swing lets them.

marks.title: Pulled gait again
marks.text: Cruise speed, hanging a little behind her tips, the trolleybus behind her.
facts: a short flare and one pull
